$comment: Presentation metadata for tools/plan_suggestion_sync.py. This file is OPTIONAL and is
deliberately not the source of truth for which abilities are cooldowns -- that set is
derived from the sampled pulls themselves (any ability whose pool-median inter-cast gap
clears MIN_RECHARGE_S). A curated list would have been wrong in two verified ways here:
the talent tree gives Incarnation as 394013 and Celestial Alignment as 395022, while every
cast event logs 102560 and 194223; and Wild Charge casts as 102383 in Moonkin Form, not
the class-wide 102401. Both would have matched nothing, with no error.
So this file does two smaller jobs: it names a role for the ids we have seen (which drives
lane grouping and colour in the site's fight timeline), and it denies ids that pass the gap
test without encoding a decision. Anything not listed still appears, as 'unclassified'.
Every id below was observed in Casts events on Heroic Venomous Abyss pulls sampled
2026-09-09; names are as the reports' own ability tables render them.

194223.note: Celestial Alignment -- the CA/Inc slot untalented

102560.note: Incarnation: Chosen of Elune -- the CA/Inc slot when talented

274281.note: New Moon -- first link of the moon chain

29166.note: Innervate -- cast on a healer, not on self

78675.note: Solar Beam -- the CAST id. The interrupt/silence effect is 97547 and is a different number; see .claude/knowledge/midnight-s2-dungeons.md.

61391.note: Typhoon -- the CAST id. The tooltip's 132469 is the effect and matches ZERO cast events in every log; this file originally carried 132469 and the generator's own observed-id output is what caught it. Same split as Solar Beam.

102383.note: Wild Charge -- the Moonkin Form id, not 102401

1293316.note: Empowering Venom -- on-use trinket (Wowhead: 'Item Effect'). Not a class ability; it appears here because the candidate set is derived from casts, which is the point: trinket timing was the single largest finding in the Coiled Altar audit.

22842.note: Frenzied Regeneration -- Bear Form self-heal, used to survive a specific hit

denyNotes.24858: Moonkin Form -- clears the gap test (recast after a knockback) but is not a plan row
denyNotes.8936: Regrowth -- an emergency self-heal, cast reactively
denyNotes.1126: Mark of the Wild -- a pre-pull buff, not a timeline entry
denyNotes.190984: Wrath -- a filler. It clears the gap test only because most sampled players cast it exactly once (the opener), which makes its one 'gap' the whole fight.
denyNotes.1233272: Lunar Eclipse -- a ~32s charge cooldown the APL owns. It clears the gap test honestly (9 casts a pull, 25.8s median gap) and is correctly classified 'on-cooldown', but it is rotation, not a plan row, so it is cut before it can crowd the list.
denyNotes.1233346: Solar Eclipse -- the same button in its other mode
